title: Q31 · Slide along a diagonal groove
description: Release the block from rest and watch gravity carry it along the 5 m groove. The plane tilts 30°; the groove is 30° to the horizontal cross-slope edge. Playback ends at O. No impact or stop is modeled.

title: Q90 · A block between two springs
description: A 4 kg block is released with both springs unstretched. The upper 100 N/m spring stretches while the lower 300 N/m spring compresses. With ideal springs and no damping, the motion repeats. Spring lengths and body dimensions are stated display choices.
